UpdateSourceArgs: -c "cd arma2/33905; find Keys -name \"*.bikey\" ! -name \"bi.bikey\" ! -name \"bi2.bikey\" -delete; IFS=\";\" read -ra subdirs_array <<< \"{{mod}}\"; for subdir in \"${subdirs_array[@]}\"; do [ -d \"$subdir/keys\" ] && \cp \"$subdir/keys/\"*.bikey Keys/ >/dev/null 2>&1; [ -d \"$subdir/key\" ] && \cp \"$subdir/key/\"*.bikey Keys/ >/dev/null 2>&1; done"

-NoProfile -Command "$mods = \"{{mod}}\" -split ';'; Set-Location arma2\33905; Remove-Item '.\keys\*.bikey' -Exclude 'bi.bikey', 'bi2.bikey' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $mods | ForEach-Object { if (Test-Path \".\$_\keys\") { Copy-Item -Path \".\$_\keys\*.bikey\" -Destination '.\Keys' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; if (Test-Path \".\$_\key\") { Copy-Item -Path \".\$_\key\*.bikey\" -Destination '.\Keys' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }"
